title: UI/UX Design Foundations
subtitle: A practical 30-day learning path for curious beginners

lessons.title: Introduction to UI & UX
lessons.description: Understand the difference between what an interface looks like and how it works.
lessons.task: Compare 2 apps: note 3 UI details and 3 UX observations

lessons.title: Design Thinking
lessons.description: Use a simple process to understand, define, explore, build, and test ideas.
lessons.task: Submit one problem statement and a five-step design thinking board

lessons.title: UX Research Basics
lessons.description: Learn when and how to gather evidence from people who use a product.
lessons.task: Write 5 neutral questions and a participant recruitment plan

lessons.title: Interviews & Competitor Analysis
lessons.description: Ask useful interview questions and compare existing products thoughtfully.
lessons.task: Interview 2 people and compare 2 existing products

lessons.title: Personas & Empathy Maps
lessons.description: Turn research notes into a grounded picture of a user and their needs.
lessons.task: Create one persona using interview notes; label any assumptions

lessons.title: User Journey Maps
lessons.description: Map what a person does, thinks, and feels across a complete experience.
lessons.task: Map a current user journey for your app concept

lessons.title: Problem Statements & HMW
lessons.description: Turn research findings into a focused problem and possible design ideas.
lessons.task: Submit 1 problem statement, 3 HMWs and 4 ideas

lessons.title: Information Architecture
lessons.description: Organize content so people can find what they need.
lessons.task: Build a content inventory and draft navigation groups

lessons.title: Sitemaps & Navigation
lessons.description: Structure screens and navigation into a clear product map.
lessons.task: Deliver a sitemap with at least 12 screens

lessons.title: User Flows & Task Flows
lessons.description: Show the steps and decisions within a key user task.
lessons.task: Create a complete main task flow with one error branch

lessons.title: Low-Fidelity Wireframes
lessons.description: Explore screen structure quickly before applying visual detail.
lessons.task: Sketch 5 app screens based on the flow

lessons.title: Figma Essentials
lessons.description: Learn the core Figma tools used to create interface layouts.
lessons.task: Recreate one sign-in UI from reference using basic tools

lessons.title: Typography for Interfaces
lessons.description: Create a readable type scale for digital products.
lessons.task: Create a 4–6-level type scale and annotate uses

lessons.title: Color Theory & Accessibility
lessons.description: Choose purposeful colors and test text contrast.
lessons.task: Create a small palette and test at least 3 pairs

lessons.title: Layout, Spacing & Grids
lessons.description: Use grids, alignment, and spacing for clear layouts.
lessons.task: Rebuild a card with annotated spacing values

lessons.title: Auto Layout & Constraints
lessons.description: Make layouts adapt when content or screen sizes change.
lessons.task: Make two responsive card components using auto layout

lessons.title: Components & Variants
lessons.description: Build reusable interface elements and their different states.
lessons.task: Build buttons with two sizes and three states

lessons.title: Design Systems & Variables
lessons.description: Keep design choices consistent with shared styles and variables.
lessons.task: Build a mini design system: color, type, buttons and inputs

lessons.title: Mobile UI Patterns
lessons.description: Apply familiar mobile patterns to useful screen states.
lessons.task: Design three core app screen states

lessons.title: High-Fidelity UI
lessons.description: Turn wireframes into polished, consistent app screens.
lessons.task: Complete five hi-fi screens of your app

lessons.title: Prototyping & Interactions
lessons.description: Connect screens to show interactions and key journeys.
lessons.task: Submit a clickable main flow and one error state

lessons.title: Responsive Web Design
lessons.description: Adapt web layouts for desktop and mobile screens.
lessons.task: Wireframe a responsive landing page in two widths

lessons.title: Landing Page Design
lessons.description: Create a landing page with clear hierarchy and action.
lessons.task: Submit desktop and mobile landing page UI

lessons.title: Usability Testing
lessons.description: Observe people using a prototype and record what happens.
lessons.task: Run 2 short tests and record 3 findings

lessons.title: Heuristics & Accessibility
lessons.description: Find usability issues and improve accessibility.
lessons.task: Audit 2 screens and propose 5 improvements

lessons.title: Developer Handoff
lessons.description: Prepare design files and notes that developers can use.
lessons.task: Prepare annotated developer handoff for 2 screens

lessons.title: UX Case Study Structure
lessons.description: Explain the problem, process, evidence, and outcome of a project.
lessons.task: Write a truthful 1-page case study outline

lessons.title: Portfolio Storytelling
lessons.description: Present design work as a clear and honest story.
lessons.task: Draft project overview and presentation flow

lessons.title: Careers & Interviews
lessons.description: Prepare to discuss your work and design decisions in interviews.
lessons.task: Prepare answers to 5 beginner interview questions

lessons.title: Final Project Review
lessons.description: Review your app, landing page, and case study with feedback.
lessons.task: Submit app, landing page and case study for feedback
